description: This Java class implements an immutable command for retrieving feature definitions in a live query context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends a base query class and provides methods for creating instances, accessing features, setting headers, and generating answer builders.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl
